supervision_overview_blind_sessions_help: Sessions seen on only one surface. Obot cannot follow data between surfaces it does not observe.
supervision_kill_switch_description: Deny every action at a scope, on every surface, within seconds.
supervision_kill_target_placeholder: User ID, agent name or session ID
supervision_kill_reason_placeholder: Why every action in this scope must stop
supervision_kill_ttl_help: Leave empty to keep the kill until it is revoked.
supervision_kill_org_warning: An organization kill stops every agent for every user.
supervision_redteam_description: Synthetic attack scenarios replayed through every surface.
supervision_redteam_empty: The red team ran no scenarios.
supervision_sessions_description: Every agent session Obot observed, stitched across surfaces.
supervision_sessions_filter_query_placeh: Search by title, user, agent or session ID
supervision_session_kill_confirm: Kill this session? Every further action in it is denied on every surface.
supervision_session_killed_banner: This session was killed. Every action in it is denied.
supervision_session_end_confirm: End this session? New activity from the same agent starts a new session.
supervision_session_warrant_description: Bind the session to a declared task. Actions outside its scopes count as drift, which policies can act on.
supervision_session_warrant_task_placeho: fix the flaky test in obot-platform/obot
supervision_policies_description: One CEL condition plus an effect, evaluated at every surface. Shadow policies record what they would have done without changing the outcome.
supervision_policy_condition_help: A CEL expression over subject, action, session and org. It must evaluate to a boolean.
supervision_policy_effect_help_allow: Allow the action and record nothing special.
supervision_policy_effect_help_log: Allow the action and flag it in the session.
supervision_policy_effect_help_redact: Remove sensitive spans before the action proceeds.
supervision_policy_effect_help_downshift: Downshift the session's credentials to read-only.
supervision_policy_effect_help_quarantin: Route untrusted content through the quarantined model.
supervision_policy_effect_help_judge: Hand the action to the Supervisor, which chooses allow, require approval or deny.
supervision_policy_effect_help_require_a: Hold the action until an approver decides.
supervision_policy_mode_enforce_help: Enforce changes the outcome of matching actions.
supervision_policy_mode_shadow_help: Shadow records what the policy would have done without changing anything. Start here.
supervision_policy_surfaces_help: Leave every surface unchecked to apply the policy everywhere.
supervision_policy_priority_help: Higher wins between policies with the same effect.
supervision_policy_guidance_help: Plain-language guidance the Supervisor follows when it judges a matching action.
supervision_policy_guidance_placeholder: Allow routine development commands; escalate anything that sends data out.
supervision_policy_approvers_help: Comma-separated: admin, manager, group:<name>, user:<id>. Empty means admin.
supervision_policy_approval_ttl_help: How long a held action waits for a decision. Empty uses the default.
supervision_policy_draft_description: Describe the rule. The Supervisor writes the condition and tests it against examples.
supervision_policy_draft_placeholder: Never let customer data reach a paste site, and ask me before any PII goes to an external host.
supervision_policy_draft_applied: Draft applied to the form. Review it before saving.
supervision_policy_draft_unavailable: The Supervisor is not available, so policies cannot be drafted.
supervision_policy_simulate_description: Replay recorded decisions against this policy before enforcing it.
supervision_policy_simulate_fp_help: Share of matches on sessions that never tripped an enforced policy.
supervision_cheat_subject: Who the action is for: the user and the actor acting on their behalf.
supervision_cheat_action: The normalized action being decided, on any surface.
supervision_cheat_session: The session's accumulated state at decision time.
supervision_cheat_host_matches: host matches any pattern, such as "*.example.com" or "example.com"
supervision_approvals_description: Actions held for a person to decide. The Supervisor's recommendation comes first.
supervision_presence_off_body: I'm switched off. Policies still decide on their own, but I'm not judging gray-area actions, triaging approvals or writing briefings.
supervision_presence_unconfigured: I need a model before I can start.
supervision_briefing_none: I don't have a briefing yet. Check back once agents start working.
supervision_briefing_unavailable: My briefing isn't available right now.
supervision_attention_description: Review held actions, suggested tool labels, and policy recommendations.
supervision_insights_unavailable: My findings aren't available right now.
supervision_insight_confirm_kill: {label}? Every further action in this scope is denied on every surface.
supervision_feed_empty: Nothing to report yet. I'll narrate every decision here as agents act.
supervision_voice_judged_allow: I reviewed {action} and let it through.
supervision_voice_judged_hold: I reviewed {action} and held it for you to decide.
supervision_voice_killed: I stopped {action}. The kill switch is on.
supervision_voice_honeytoken: I blocked {action}. A honeytoken was in the outbound data.
supervision_voice_shadow: I let {action} through. If {policy} were enforced, the outcome would be: {effect}.
supervision_ask_placeholder: Ask about any session, decision or policy...
supervision_ask_suggest_riskiest: What's the riskiest thing happening right now?
supervision_ask_suggest_last_hold: Why did you hold the last action?
supervision_ask_suggest_next_policy: Which policy should I enforce next?
supervision_ask_suggest_session_safe: Is it safe to let this session continue?
supervision_ask_suggest_session_data: What sensitive data has this session touched?
supervision_ask_unavailable: I can't answer questions until I'm configured with a model.
supervision_ask_intro: I can explain any decision I made, any session I watched, or what to do next.
supervision_ask_session_intro: Ask me anything about this session.
supervision_commentary_subtitle: What I see in this session
supervision_recommend_escalate: This one needs a person. I'm not confident either way.
supervision_recommend_none: I haven't weighed in on this one yet. It's your call.
supervision_suggests_description: Shadow policies that would have caught real activity. Enforce them when you're ready.
supervision_tool_labels_description: I suggest labels from saved tool descriptions and parameters. Review them before they affect policy decisions.
supervision_tool_labels_choose_resource: Open an MCP or vMCP and choose Review tool labels to inspect its saved tools.
supervision_tool_labels_stale_error: The saved tools or suggestions changed. Review the refreshed list and generate new suggestions before approving.
supervision_tool_labels_sidecar: Labels are reviewed metadata in Obot. Approving them does not modify the MCP or vMCP configuration, including Git-managed files.
supervision_tool_labels_readonly: Only an administrator can generate suggestions or approve label changes.
supervision_tool_labels_empty: No saved tools are available. Generate or refresh the tool previews in the resource editor, then return here.
supervision_tool_labels_stale: This tool changed after the suggestion was generated. Generate a new suggestion.
supervision_tool_labels_unchanged: The suggested labels match the current labels.
supervision_attention_unavailable: Some pending reviews could not be loaded. Retrying shortly.
supervision_labels_intro: See which labels are in use, where they come from, and which suggestions need administrator review.
supervision_labels_resources_help: Effective labels apply now. Suggestions stay separate until approved. Label assignments live in Obot, including for Git-managed resources.
supervision_labels_empty_resources: No resources with saved tools or label records are available. Generate tool previews for an MCP or vMCP to get started.
supervision_labels_no_matches: No labels or resources match these filters.
supervision_labels_ai_help: Optional and off by default. AI can add content labels, but cannot remove labels found by deterministic scanning. Scanning still runs when AI tagging is off.
supervision_labels_ai_sync: New AI labels can be added before the next decision, within the configured time budget.
supervision_labels_ai_async: AI labeling runs asynchronously. New labels inform later decisions.
supervision_labels_capabilities_help: Describe what a tool can do. Heuristics provide initial labels. AI suggestions are advisory until an administrator approves them.
supervision_labels_content_help: Describe information that enters a session. Scanners and tool capabilities add labels; the optional AI tagger can add more. Session labels accumulate as the agent reads.
supervision_labels_observed_help: Runtime observations and older assignments keyed by server name. An AI source here does not mean an administrator approved it. Use Resources to review assignments for a specific MCP or vMCP.
supervision_labels_empty_observed: No observed tool label records are available yet.
supervision_labels_meaning_reads_private: Reads organization-private data, such as customer records, files or internal documents.
supervision_labels_meaning_reads_untrust: Reads material an outsider could have written, such as web pages, inbound email or public issues.
supervision_labels_meaning_writes_extern: Can send information outside the organization.
supervision_labels_meaning_writes_intern: Can create or update information within an organization system.
supervision_labels_meaning_exec: Can execute code or shell commands.
supervision_labels_meaning_destructive: Can delete data or make destructive changes.
supervision_labels_meaning_credential_be: Can carry or return credentials, keys or tokens.
supervision_labels_meaning_pii: Information that identifies a person, such as an email address or government identifier.
supervision_labels_meaning_secret: Credentials or other secrets, such as access tokens and private keys.
supervision_labels_meaning_customer_data: Information about customers and their records.
supervision_labels_meaning_source_code: Source code, configuration or infrastructure definitions.
supervision_labels_meaning_health: Health or medical information about a person.
supervision_labels_meaning_confidential: Organization-private information that is not intended for external sharing.
supervision_labels_meaning_untrusted: Material an outsider could influence, including possible instructions aimed at an agent.
supervision_labels_meaning_honeytoken: A planted canary credential or record used to detect an attempted data transfer.
supervision_labels_meaning_other: A label reported by this server version.
supervision_tagging_description: Lets the Supervisor's model add sensitivity and trust labels to content entering agent sessions, beyond the built-in scan. It only adds labels. Content is sent to the model through the LLM gateway and never stored.
supervision_tagging_mode_sync: Real time, before the next decision
supervision_tagging_only_unlabeled: Only content the built-in scan found no sensitive data in
supervision_tagging_queue: {queued} items waiting for the next batch
